info.name: GigDesk API
info.description: Complete GigDesk API collection — VERIFIED 2026-08-31 live on http://127.0.0.1:4000 (also https://api-gigdesk-production.up.railway.app). All bodies MUST be double-quoted JSON. Admin: Bearer {{adminToken}} (POST /auth/login). Worker: Bearer {{workerToken}} (POST /worker/otp/verify). Phone accepts plain 10-digit OR +91 (normalized). Register accepts surname+name OR fullName + email,address,district,profilePhotoUrl,drivingLicenseUrl. OTP verify returns pre-worker JWT for unregistered phone. Uploads mock when S3 not set. Every endpoint includes verified 200/201 example response below. Src: src/app.ts + src/modules/*/routes.ts + schemas.ts. Invalid JSON → 400 {error:'Invalid JSON'}.
